source_note: CRON 2026-10-07: whole balance sheet replaced with the audited group figures for FY2025 and FY2024 read from _ngx_pdf/UACN.pdf p.29, unit N'000 x1000. The file previously carried two periods and held raw N'000 values (1000x below the whole-unit convention the panel formats), a blank total liabilities row, and equity cells that were the company column of other years (FY2023 5,000, FY2022 29,535,041,000 and FY2021 43,154,419,000 are the company 31-Dec-2025 and 31-Dec-2024 figures). Those unverifiable columns were dropped rather than carried. Assets 305,848,101 + 291,139,099 + 70,897 = 597,058,097; liabilities 232,691,347 + 294,596,180 = 527,287,527; assets less liabilities = 69,770,570 equity, all in N'000.
